title: Love it!
text: Love it!. This photo album is wonderful - would definitely buy again!

product_metadata.title: Jot & Mark Photo Album Set - 200 4x6 Photos, Clear Pocket Sleeves, 6 Tab Dividers, 3-Ring Binder 8.5x9.5 (Champagne Symphony)
features: COMPLETE SET | Includes everything needed to start organizing and storing family photographs. Includes album, protectives sleeves, and premium gold-foiled tabbed dividers
ENDURING KEEPSAKE | Each binder features sturdy construction, quality design, and archival printing.
DELIGHTFULLY SIZED | Each page holds two standard 4” x 6” horizontal photographs. The binder is 8.5” wide and 9.5” tall, so it fits nicely on a standard bookshelf
SAFE STORAGE | Pictures are safe from spills and moisture inside the included clear vinyl sleeves. These acid-free sleeves are side-loading, so pictures stay securely inside when the album is closed
EASY ORGANIZING | The binder includes 50 2-pocket photo sleeves and six tabbed dividers, so you can organize, sort, and arrange your photos by theme, event, or season
